item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0014-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0014-E002","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"A July 2023 Cyberspace Administration notice required platforms to verify self-media account information and, for specified professional fields, credentials; require source labeling; demand responsibility for information authenticity; label fabricated or disputed content; mark rumors and promote debunking; and impose specified restrictions or sanctions on noncompliant accounts.","notes":["The excerpt supports restrictions and sanctions for specified categories of violations, but not the summary’s broad wording that all noncompliant accounts were restricted or removed."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0014-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0014-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0014-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0014-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0014-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0014-E008","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
